episodes.name: 100 A.D. (1)
episodes.overview: Stan offers a reward to the person who can stop Hayley and her old boyfriend from eloping.

episodes.name: Son of Stan (2)
episodes.overview: Francine and Stan compare parenting skills after Stan creates a clone of Steve; Roger searches for the missing bride and groom.

episodes.name: Best Little Horror House in Langley Falls
episodes.overview: Wanting to have the scariest haunted house on the block, Stan comes up with a ''killer'' setup; Steve competes to win the heart of his overprotective friend's younger sister.

episodes.name: Stan's Food Restaurant
episodes.overview: Stan is ecstatic when Roger offers to help him live out his lifelong dream of opening a restaurant to rival his favorite childhood haunt - until their different visions for what the eatery should be cause havoc. Meanwhile, Steve meets Ashley, the new girl in school who invites him over while her parents are out of town.

episodes.name: White Rice
episodes.overview: After an argument between Stan and Francine breaks out, Stan suggests they go see a counselor, who hypnotizes Francine and reawakens her lifelong dream of being a comedian. Meanwhile, back in Langley Falls, Steve brings home a potential love interest for Klaus.

episodes.name: There Will Be Bad Blood
episodes.overview: It’s Thanksgiving in Langley Falls, and as usual, Stan invites his half-brother, Rusty, over to show off his cornucopia of wealth and good fortune. But when Stan finds out that Rusty is far wealthier than he led on, Stan tries to take from Rusty what he feels is rightfully his. Things don’t go well, and the Smith family nearly loses it all.

episodes.name: The People vs. Martin Sugar
episodes.overview: If there’s one thing that Stan Smith loves, it’s a good jury trial. He anxiously awaits his annual jury summons. But when Roger is the defendant in the trial where Stan is the foreman, he is finally in a position to make Roger accountable for his misdeeds. Meanwhile, Jeff and Hayley move in with the Smiths, and Francine tries to get Jeff to clean up his act.

episodes.name: For Whom the Sleigh Bell Tolls
episodes.overview: Despite Francine's warning, Stan gives Steve a gun for Christmas; Steve accidentally shoots Santa.

episodes.name: Fart-break Hotel
episodes.overview: When Roger releases lethal gas into the Smith residence, the family moves into a hotel while the fumes clear.

episodes.name: Stanny Boy and Frantastic
episodes.overview: Stan and Francine have trouble keeping up with a younger couple's lifestyle.

episodes.name: A Piñata Named Desire
episodes.overview:
With a flair for the dramatic, Roger invites Stan to attend one of his acting classes.

However, tempers flare when they both audition for the same role, leaving them to duke it out for top dog.

Meanwhile, Steve and his friends get into a pillow fight when they try to plan the greatest slumber party ever.

episodes.name: You Debt Your Life
episodes.overview: After an argument with Stan, Roger moves out of the house and is subsequently replaced. Meanwhile, Steve acquires a new job at Pearl Bailey High School.

episodes.name: I Am the Walrus
episodes.overview: When Steve challenges Stan for family dominance, Stan does everything he can to prove to Steve that he is the alpha male of the Smith house. Meanwhile, Hayley and Jeff seek marriage counseling when the honeymoon phase wears off.

episodes.name: School Lies
episodes.overview:
In an attempt to advance in the CIA, Stan enrolls Steve in the same private school as Senator Buckingham's daughter.

After Steve quits and joins a Latina street gang, Roger fills in & things are going well until Roger accidentally sells the senator’s daughter to a drug lord.

episodes.name: License to Till
episodes.overview: When Steve has trouble crossing over into the "cool kids" social circle, Klaus and Roger place their bets to see how quickly Roger can make him cool. Everything they try backfires until Steve becomes the in-crowds designated driver. Meanwhile, Stan and Francine take turns pranking each other.

episodes.name: Jenny Fromdabloc
episodes.overview: After Snot professes his love for Hayley and gets shot down, Steve and Roger devise a plan to cheer him up. Roger dresses up as Steve’s cousin from New Jersey, Jenny Fromdabloc, and Snot falls hard for her. Meanwhile, Stan wants to live like a gentleman of the 1960s, complete with dark suits and dry martinis.

episodes.name: Home Wrecker
episodes.overview: Stan and Francine fight over how to redecorate the house. It goes so far that they split the house down the middle and try to live without each other. Meanwhile, Principal Lewis discovers a talent of Barry.

episodes.name: Flirting With Disaster
episodes.overview:
Francine gets a job at Stan’s office, which cramps Stan’s style and his ability to flirt with co-workers.

When Francine retaliates with a little flirting of her own, war breaks out at work.

episodes.name: Gorillas in the Mist
episodes.overview: Bonding with Steve at the zoo causes Stan to lose Steve in the gorilla cage.
